d:
Welcome to my Venice vlog! I finally ticked Italy off my dream destination list, and it was as magical as I had imagined. And as adventurous as I had not (honestly ).
From the enchanting canals to the historic streets, Venice captured my heart in every way.
Join me as I take you on an adventure ride in this mesmerizing city in part 1 of the Venice vlog.
Airtel is what truly made this journey smooth. Irrespective of all the hiccups their dependable international roaming service was my lifeline. It allowed me to share live updates, seek advice, stay connected and solve problems on the go.
